notes: Encoded ONLY from Hot Dawg's own page (Modine). No system imported from any other page. All three page styles ship; Style 2 ships year-only because its month is a chart-only letter.

styles.era: 14-character serials (6 digits + 3 letters + 5 digits), year + month
styles.notes: Page positions (1-based): year = 1st-4th numerical digits (4-digit year, used as-is), month = 5th-6th numerical digits.

styles.era: 9-character serials (2 digits + 4 letters + 3 digits), year only
styles.notes: Year = 1st-2nd numerical digits ('97' -> 1997). Month = 3rd character letter, stated as 'see chart', so chart-only and NOT encoded; ships year-only per precedent. NOTE: the page description says 'five (5) letters' but the example serial 97JKGK153 contains four letters (J,K,G,K); the pattern follows the example, not the description count. Disjoint from styles 1 and 3 (starts with digits, length 9).

Page positions (1-based): year = 6th-7th numerical digits, month = 8th-9th numerical digits. CHARACTER counting ships per the Nordyne lesson: digit-only counting is falsified (the serial contains only 5 digits, so there is no 6th/7th numerical digit), while character counting decodes the example exactly ('87' -> 1987, '01' -> January). Disjoint from style 2 (starts with letters).
